name: Rijksmuseum
body: A Permissions-Policy, a Referrer-Policy, nosniff, and a sitemap named in robots.txt. But Strict-Transport-Security sets max-age to 30 days, and http:// reaches https through a temporary 307.
lesson: Raise HSTS max-age to at least a year, ideally two, and make the http redirect permanent with a 301.
summary: www.rijksmuseum.nl scores 79 out of 100 (C). 1 check fails now, 22 are at risk, and 17 pass. Fix first: 41 images have no alt attribute.

fix.title: 41 images have no alt attribute
fix.fix: Describe informative images. Give decorative ones alt="".

fix.title: Security headers on the start page are missing on other pages
fix.evidence: HSTS on 1 page, Content-Security-Policy on 2 pages, X-Content-Type-Options on 1 page, Referrer-Policy on 1 page, Permissions-Policy on 1 page, out of 20 pages analyzed. Attackers pick the weakest page.
fix.fix: Set the headers once at the server, CDN, or host config so every response carries them.

fix.title: 5 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /en/footer/cookie-policy, /en/login?redirectUrl=https://www.rijksmuseum.nl/en, /en/collection, /en/support and 1 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

fix.title: The start page took 1951 ms to arrive
fix.evidence: That is the HTML alone, before images and scripts.
fix.fix: Cache the HTML at the edge, or speed up the server render.

fix.title: 31 images have no width or height
fix.evidence: The layout jumps when they load, which hurts Cumulative Layout Shift.
fix.fix: Set width and height (or aspect-ratio) on images.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
The start page declares its language
Core Web Vitals pass for real visitors
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
